description: An early `return` is added between `_cache_lock.acquire()` and `_cache_lock.release()`: when the key already exists the function returns while still holding the module-global lock, so every subsequent acquire deadlocks. Unlike a refcount-closed file handle, this is an unambiguous, non-recoverable bug.

expected.note: early return on line 10 skips _cache_lock.release(); the acquire/leak span is lines 8-12
